criteria.statement: GIVEN no vocoder-result.json exists at $RUNNER_TEMP WHEN commit-locale-files.sh runs THEN it exits 0 having written nothing and staged nothing
criteria.test: tests/commit-locale-files.test.sh::returns early when no result file exists

criteria.statement: GIVEN a result file whose status is not "complete" WHEN commit-locale-files.sh runs THEN it exits 0 having written nothing
criteria.test: tests/commit-locale-files.test.sh::returns early when status is not complete

criteria.statement: GIVEN a result file naming the paths the CLI wrote WHEN commit-locale-files.sh runs THEN every one of those paths is staged via git add. Amended by VOC-115: the original criterion had this script write the tree to disk and stage its keys, which is the bug VOC-115 removes — the CLI is now the only writer and this script stages what it reports.
criteria.test: tests/commit-locale-files.test.sh::stages the paths the CLI reported writing

criteria.statement: GIVEN the written files are identical to what is already committed WHEN commit-locale-files.sh runs THEN it exits 0 without proceeding to commit-dispatch.sh
criteria.test: tests/commit-locale-files.test.sh::exits before dispatch when written content matches what is already committed

criteria.statement: GIVEN a result file where apps[].commitConfig.commitMode is set WHEN commit-locale-files.sh runs THEN that server-provided value is used over the action's own commit-mode input ($VOCODER_COMMIT_MODE)
criteria.test: tests/commit-locale-files.test.sh::server-provided commitMode overrides the action's own commit-mode input

criteria.statement: GIVEN a result file with real file changes WHEN commit-locale-files.sh completes its own work THEN it hands off to commit-dispatch.sh with the correct TARGET_BRANCH, COMMIT_MODE, AUTO_MERGE, and SKIP_CI values
criteria.test: tests/commit-locale-files.test.sh::hands off to commit-dispatch.sh with the correct target branch, auto-merge, and skip-ci values
